newsitem.title: USA: U.S. 52-week bills seen at average 5.35 pct rate.
newsitem.headline: U.S. 52-week bills seen at average 5.35 pct rate.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $13.0 billion in 52-week bills on Thursday was expected to garner an average discount rate of 5.35 percent, traders said.
In when-issued trade at about 1245 EDT/1645 GMT, the 52-week bill was at 5.353 percent.
Dealers said they expected good demand, particularly from retail since the new issue is a quarter-end bill.
The bidding deadline for the auction is 1300 EDT/1700 GMT. Results are expected around 1345 EDT/1745 GMT.
